# frostyard.problem/1 shared test vectors for the std problems package (Go)
# and the frostyard-problems crate (Rust). Format: README.md in this folder.
# Contract: frostyard/core docs/specs/problem-report.md.

# A valid Go error. MESSAGE is local only; it never reaches the payload.
vector: go-error
type: write
in.app_id: org.frostyard.nsl
in.version: 1.2.3
in.component: cli
in.runtime: go
in.class: error
in.code: config.load
in.message: open /etc/nsl.conf: permission denied
journal.MESSAGE_ID: 8915bdd215c84cbab0c31c05a1a33e7e
journal.PRIORITY: 3
journal.MESSAGE: open /etc/nsl.conf: permission denied
journal.FROSTYARD_SCHEMA: frostyard.problem/1
journal.FROSTYARD_APP_ID: org.frostyard.nsl
journal.FROSTYARD_APP_VERSION: 1.2.3
journal.FROSTYARD_RUNTIME: go
journal.FROSTYARD_COMPONENT: cli
journal.FROSTYARD_CLASS: error
journal.FROSTYARD_CODE: config.load
payload.app_id: org.frostyard.nsl
payload.app_version: 1.2.3
payload.runtime: go
payload.component: cli
payload.class: error
payload.code: config.load
expect: ok

# A valid Go panic with frames, innermost first. A frame outside the allowed modules becomes other.
vector: go-panic-frames
type: write
in.app_id: org.frostyard.nsl
in.version: 1.2.3
in.component: cli
in.runtime: go
in.class: panic
in.message: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
in.frame: runtime.gopanic
in.frame: github.com/frostyard/nsl/internal/store.(*DB).Open
in.frame: github.com/spf13/cobra.(*Command).execute
in.frame: main.main
in.frame: runtime.main
in.frame: runtime.goexit
journal.MESSAGE_ID: 8915bdd215c84cbab0c31c05a1a33e7e
journal.PRIORITY: 2
journal.MESSAGE: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
journal.FROSTYARD_SCHEMA: frostyard.problem/1
journal.FROSTYARD_APP_ID: org.frostyard.nsl
journal.FROSTYARD_APP_VERSION: 1.2.3
journal.FROSTYARD_RUNTIME: go
journal.FROSTYARD_COMPONENT: cli
journal.FROSTYARD_CLASS: panic
journal.FROSTYARD_FRAMES: runtime.gopanic
journal.FROSTYARD_FRAMES: github.com/frostyard/nsl/internal/store.(*DB).Open
journal.FROSTYARD_FRAMES: other
journal.FROSTYARD_FRAMES: main.main
journal.FROSTYARD_FRAMES: runtime.main
journal.FROSTYARD_FRAMES: runtime.goexit
payload.app_id: org.frostyard.nsl
payload.app_version: 1.2.3
payload.runtime: go
payload.component: cli
payload.class: panic
payload.frames: runtime.gopanic
payload.frames: github.com/frostyard/nsl/internal/store.(*DB).Open
payload.frames: other
payload.frames: main.main
payload.frames: runtime.main
payload.frames: runtime.goexit
expect: ok

# A frostyard frame stays.
vector: frame-frostyard
type: frame
in.frame: github.com/frostyard/std/problems.(*Recorder).RecoverPanic
out.frame: github.com/frostyard/std/problems.(*Recorder).RecoverPanic

# A standard library frame stays.
vector: frame-stdlib
type: frame
in.frame: encoding/json.(*decodeState).object
out.frame: encoding/json.(*decodeState).object

# A frame of package main stays.
vector: frame-main-closure
type: frame
in.frame: main.main.func1
out.frame: main.main.func1

# A generic frame stays.
vector: frame-generic
type: frame
in.frame: github.com/frostyard/nsl/cache.Get[...]
out.frame: github.com/frostyard/nsl/cache.Get[...]

# The go-imap fork stays.
vector: frame-go-imap
type: frame
in.frame: github.com/emersion/go-imap/v2/imapclient.(*Client).Wait
out.frame: github.com/emersion/go-imap/v2/imapclient.(*Client).Wait

# A module outside the allowed list becomes other.
vector: frame-other-module
type: frame
in.frame: github.com/spf13/cobra.(*Command).Execute
out.frame: other

# A dotted import path becomes other.
vector: frame-other-dotted
type: frame
in.frame: gopkg.in/yaml.v3.(*decoder).unmarshal
out.frame: other

# A file path becomes other.
vector: frame-path
type: frame
in.frame: /home/brian/src/nsl/main.go:42
out.frame: other

# A file line with an offset becomes other.
vector: frame-path-plus
type: frame
in.frame: main.main /home/brian/src/main.go:42 +0x1d
out.frame: other

# A name with arguments becomes other.
vector: frame-args
type: frame
in.frame: main.run(0xc000012345, 0x2)
out.frame: other

# A name with no package becomes other.
vector: frame-no-package
type: frame
in.frame: panic
out.frame: other

# An empty name becomes other.
vector: frame-empty
type: frame
in.frame: 
out.frame: other

# other stays other.
vector: frame-other
type: frame
in.frame: other
out.frame: other

# A frame of exactly 160 bytes stays.
vector: frame-160
type: frame
in.frame: github.com/frostyard/nsl.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
out.frame: github.com/frostyard/nsl.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

# A frame of 161 bytes becomes other.
vector: frame-161
type: frame
in.frame: github.com/frostyard/nsl.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaab
out.frame: other

# A standard library path segment must be lowercase.
vector: frame-upper-stdlib-segment
type: frame
in.frame: net/HTTP.Serve
out.frame: other

# After github.com/frostyard at most 6 segments follow.
vector: frame-frostyard-too-deep
type: frame
in.frame: github.com/frostyard/a/b/c/d/e/f/g.F
out.frame: other
